photos.description: One of the must do things in Thailand is eating local food 'in the street', there are literally hundreds and hundreds of foodstalls everywhere you go. The Hua Hin night market is a great place to wander, barter at the hundreds of stalls and pick up a bargain while you sample food from the many stalls. This stall seems to be selling maily fruit
